doctor_backend.gpu: one pinned server per physical GPU 0..4 (five_gpu.doctor_urls)

verification.short_circuit: decide at two agreeing reruns (2 of K=3)
verification.support_order: source trajectory first, then greedy minimum shared path prefix; ties by leaf id
verification.target: member feedback behavioral locus (target_reply_id); Stage-1 Applicable required, No Match -> next candidate, not a support
verification.keep: KEEP at the first member with two target flips out of K=3; otherwise test every same-ID member until exhausted

notes.rounds: maximum Agent turns per branch (G = rollout.branching children per decision point); also used by the Agent prompt and intervention reruns
notes.budget: full_tree only; pruning / subsampling is not defined
notes.rubric: one Rubric-Generator call -> one rubric per completed trajectory (success and failure alike)
notes.rubric.gold_answer_visible: Doctor feedback and the Rubric Generator never receive a gold field (the final decision plus the outcome can imply it)
notes.post_hoc_gates: blocking: schema, deterministic leakage / answer copy, Jev answer_presupposition, Jev new_domain_premise; recorded only: observable
notes.intervention: targets = source-trajectory responses the rubric matches (two-stage applicability); the same policy writes the intervention reply and runs the continuations; failure -> Score-2 template, success -> Score-0 template; one reply, then K continuations
notes.reruns_per_intervention: K = continuations per intervention target; a rerun count, not a rubric count
notes.R_O: Target flips / K: Score-2 counts parsed success (1), Score-0 counts parsed failure (0). Unparsed FINAL (None) stays in the denominator but never counts as a flip (parsed_target_only_v1).
notes.selection: unused for training under bounded_witness_v1 (min_R_O applies only to the exhaustive protocol); prompt-search J is unchanged
notes.scoring: kept rubrics score every response node of the tree with the two-stage scorer; No Match records are kept without a score
notes.agent_reward: frozen 2026-10-07: outcome_only 1.0 / 0.0 (arm override), outcome + rubric arms 0.5 / 0.5; a rubric-only condition would be 0.0 / 1.0. Per node: w_outcome * mean(descendant outcomes) + w_rubric * R_A | r_a_weighting = equal: R_A = unweighted mean of level/2 over the applicable KEEP rubrics; verification is a gate only (R_O(R) is no longer a weight).
notes.prompt_update: One common P0/P1 comparison per four-case batch, exact same frozen trees and rerun policy; J = product of trajectory-mean directional effects across the batch. Full member verification for J, all-members witness KEEP for training. Strictly higher J wins; ties or a missing direction keep P0. No bootstrap, delta, split, or multi-candidate search.
notes.prompt_hashes: scripts/online_rl/run_tree.py refuses to launch when a prompt/template file differs from its sha256
notes.evaluation: GPU4 evaluates all 622 CasiMedicos English cases while rollout workers are pending; resumes per case; yields to update at case boundaries.
notes.data: 500 unique MedMCQA train cases (all subjects), random.Random(20261006).sample without replacement over source-order unique, non-protected train rows (manifest train_random500_seed20261006.manifest.json, source parquet sha b119434b...); gold = options[ABCD[cop]] (cop is 0-based in the source); not redistributed
notes.schedule: 500 unique train cases: original 487 non-calibration cases in their original order, then 13 deterministic TRAIN replacements (seed20261008); no reserved calibration IDs.
notes.arms: scripts/online_rl/run_tree.py --condition {outcome_only, fixed, evolving} (src/online_rl/tree/conditions.py); outcome_only = rubric.enabled false (reward = outcome component only, no feedback / rubric / verification / scoring / prompt events), fixed = prompt_update.enabled false, evolving = both on; output_dir/<arm>
notes.feedback: Feedback Generator = feedback.model, a separate role from the Doctor (rollout.doctor_model); dated snapshot pinned
notes.model_roles: Doctor rollout.doctor_model (Gemma-3-12B); Agent Qwen3-8B + LoRA; Feedback feedback.model (Claude Haiku 4.5); Rubric Generator rubric.generator_model (Gemini 3.8 Flash); Rubric Gate judges.gate_model (Luna: hard Y/N on the rubric itself: answer_presupposition, new_domain_premise, observable recorded); Rubric Scorer judges.scorer_model (Luna: Applicable / No Match, then hard level 0/1/2 -> level/2 for R_A); Reflection and Refiner prompt_update.reflection_model / refiner_model (Claude Haiku 4.5). Each model id (and judge protocol) is part of its cache key and of the run manifest.
notes.luna_alignment: strict JSON-schema output; trivial canonicalisation; at most one repair request to the same Luna model with the same input; a second invalid output is an operational error (retried on resume), never mapped or filled in
notes.rubric_reuse: same-reason REUSE vs NEW per case and outcome stratum (src/online_rl/tree/rubric_bank.py): one MATCH-vs-NEW decision per later trajectory, a new rubric only for a new reason; every member verified on its own path; KEEP iff max_j s_j >= min_R_O; R_O(R) = max_j s_j; each kept rubric scored once
notes.rubric.generation: Gemini 3.8 Flash reasons mandatorily; effort low + 4096 tokens + strict JSON schema fixes the Stage-A truncation (16/32 cut off at 1200)
notes.doctor_backend: local Ollama Doctor, protocol v2 (src/online_rl/doctor.py): hidden status, adaptive halting (min 3 Agent turns, T_max 5), seeded calls
notes.verification: all_members_witness_v1: same-ID consolidated rubric members in topology order, no support cap; each member uses its feedback locus and Stage-1 applicability. Stop at first 2-of-3 causal witness; None is never a flip.
notes.output_root: 2026-10-07: final 100+100 runs on 165.132.141.140 (compute-node, 8x RTX A6000) from case 1; outputs/sherpa_tree_v1_d1frozen (RTX 4090, stopped after Outcome-only case 1) is an aborted diagnostic: Agent tokens are hardware-dependent, so hardware is not mixed within a run
notes.doctor_opening: New five-GPU protocol: immutable runtime D1 per case/protocol, shared across saved checkpoints; no frozen VAL50 table dependency.
notes.agent_protocol: frozen 2026-10-07: independent pre-assessment followed by collaborator-conditioned response (src/online_rl/agent_protocol.py); Stage A blind to the dialogue, Stage B sees its own Stage-A assessment as hidden context; joint two-stage GRPO action; shared by every reward arm; Agent prompt prompts/agent.txt and decoding unchanged
notes.feedback_locus: feedback v4 behavior_observer_v4 (behavior_feedback_v4.txt): the writer sees ONLY the labelled physician/Agent dialogue before the FINAL (no question, options, final decision, outcome or gold) and returns answer-neutral behavioral feedback ending with "Behavioral locus: Agent reply N". Deterministic guard (option labels, option texts, correctness wording) + labels + locus: one repair with the same input; leakage still present -> invalid feedback (no redaction), and that trajectory gets no rubric mapping / is not a witness support / is not a J unit. The success / failure stratum is used by the Rubric Generator and the matcher, not by the feedback writer.
notes.prompt_search_J: One common P0/P1 comparison per four-case batch, exact same frozen trees and rerun policy; J = product of trajectory-mean directional effects across the batch. Full member verification for J, all-members witness KEEP for training. Strictly higher J wins; ties or a missing direction keep P0. No bootstrap, delta, split, or multi-candidate search.
notes.rubric_source_consistency: v2.1 (source_locus_v1): the Rubric Generator sees the feedback behavioral locus (reply id, the conversation before it and its text) and must write an applicability condition that holds at that locus; a new rubric must be Stage-1 Applicable at its own source locus before the quality gate: No Match -> one repair (same locus and feedback) -> still No Match -> SOURCE_INCONSISTENT (not admitted). Repaired rubrics get a new id (-r1). Everything after admission (REUSE, witness, K, supports, R_A, J) is as in v2.
notes.batch: Four cases per batch, one on each GPU0..3. One P0/P1 comparison then one GPU4 update. Checkpoints every six batches (24 cases), plus final500.
